# Velocity

Velocity's recorded description carries no feature list and instead presents the theme as sleek and futuristic, the product of a year-long pursuit of design perfection. Nothing about its palette, its modes or its settings is recorded, so what it actually changes in the Obsidian interface is not stated by the input this body rests on.

![Velocity screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gonzalo-d-sales/obsidian-velocity/HEAD/assets/thumbnail.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Velocity"
    author: "gonzalo-d-sales"
    repo:   "gonzalo-d-sales/obsidian-velocity"
    slug:   "velocity"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/velocity"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/gonzalo-d-sales/obsidian-velocity"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gonzalo-d-sales/obsidian-velocity/HEAD/assets/thumbnail.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Velocity is a sleek and futuristic theme for Obsidian - born out of a relentless, one-year-long pursuit of design perfection. See for yourself what it's like to use a truly next-generation theme, and take your note-taking experience to a whole new level."
}
```
